title: Eskimo 3 / Ice Pole
label: White label (WK007 per one archived listing)

type.basis: A sequel in the Eskimo series; release details rest on a single archived listing.

sound.text: Ice Pole opens with a synth melody, then drops into an aggressive, off-kilter counter-melody that the author compares to dancehall and tango; the track moves in 8-bar sections (Son Raw, Complex).

context.text: Complex says Ice Pole's opening melody helped inspire the 'sinogrime' subgenre.
Mixmag and FACT both name 'Ice Pole' among Wiley's eskibeat tracks.

rels.other: Eskimo (Wiley, 2002); Wikipedia lists 'Eskimo 3' as a sequel

uncertainty: The catalogue number WK007, the year 2002 and the A/B order come only from a resold eBay auction record (popsike), a weak source. No sound description of 'Eskimo 3' itself was found. Treat the release metadata as provisional.
tracklist: A: Ice Pole; B: Eskimo 3 (taken from the seller description of a 2014 eBay auction archived on popsike).

audit.note: Not found in web searches of music.apple.com.
Not found via web searches restricted to qobuz.com (Qobuz's own catalogue search needs JS/app); absence is less certain than on Apple.
Not found via web search restricted to bandcamp.com (only bootlegs/remixes or unrelated items surfaced). Third-party Ice Pole bootlegs/refixes exist.
